id: W:oliveira|historia do estado do espirito santo
original_title: História do Estado do Espírito Santo
note: The 2008 third edition is by José Teixeira de Oliveira, not José Amauri de Oliveira. The candidate is a different author and a different book.

original_title: Through the Prism of Slavery: Labor, Capital, and World Economy
note: Catalogue explicitly identifies the 2011 Portuguese book as a translation of this English original.

original_title: Visual Pleasure and Narrative Cinema
note: The individual Screen article is not the containing collection Visual and Other Pleasures.

original_title: Tacitus
note: Syme’s two-volume study is absent. Ten Studies in Tacitus is a different book. The catalogue records the ISBN for the original-language set/reprint.

original_title: The Cambridge History of China, Volume 1: The Ch’in and Han Empires, 221 B.C.–A.D. 220
note: The joint editors Twitchett and Loewe identify volume 1, first published in 1986; 1998 is a later printing/date. The candidate Cambridge History of Ancient China is a different volume edited by Loewe and Shaughnessy.

original_title: A Historical Commentary on Thucydides
note: The five-volume commentary appeared in 1945–1981, with Andrewes and Dover completing later volumes. None of Gomme’s supplied candidates is this work.

id: W:bede|ecclesiastical history of the english people
original_title: Historia ecclesiastica gentis Anglorum
note: The 1969 Colgrave–Mynors edition contains parallel Latin and English. Prefer the original Latin work represented by the 1475 incipit record over its English editions, including w-121589.

original_title: Introduction à la socio-histoire
note: La Découverte, Repères 437; no supplied candidate is this introductory book.

original_title: A Tour in Scotland, MDCCLXIX
note: The cited 1774 third edition was reprinted in facsimile by Melven Press in 1979. It is distinct from the tour and Hebrides voyage of 1772.

original_title: Dictionnaire de la langue française
note: Most likely Littré’s dictionary, here in the 1873–1874 edition. The author-field fragment “Review of” may instead indicate an unidentified review; no reviewer or venue is supplied.

original_title: The Plantation Machine: Atlantic Capitalism in French Saint-Domingue and British Jamaica
note: Matches the shortened candidate title. Its 2020 date and “other” kind are metadata discrepancies: publisher and author repository identify the 2016 coauthored book; the repository deposit dates to 2020.

original_title: The Prose of Counter-Insurgency
container: Subaltern Studies II (1983), pp. 1–42; reprinted in Selected Subaltern Studies (1988), pp. 45–86
note: The Spanish La prosa de la contrainsurgencia is the same essay, although the graph labels it an article. Do not match the whole Selected Subaltern Studies or Small Voice of History collections.

id: W:dunbar ortiz|indigenous peoples history of the united states
original_title: An Indigenous Peoples’ History of the United States
note: Beacon Press first edition; the sole supplied candidate is an unrelated 1974 thesis.

original_title: The Aztecs Under Spanish Rule: A History of the Indians of the Valley of Mexico, 1519–1810
note: Charles Gibson’s Stanford University Press monograph; no candidates supplied.

id: W:cobbett|parliamentary history of england from the earliest period to the year 1803
original_title: The Parliamentary History of England, from the Earliest Period to the Year 1803
note: The 36-volume Cobbett/Hansard compilation appeared in 1806–1820. None of Cobbett’s supplied works represents it.

original_title: Against the Grain: A Deep History of the Earliest States
note: Scott’s 2017 Yale book is absent from the candidates. ISBN identifies its original-year ebook.

original_title: The Shaping of Peace: Canada and the Search for World Order, 1943–1957
note: John W. Holmes’s two-volume work began in 1979; the confirmed original ISBN is for volume 1. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Beyond Words
note: Auslander’s AHR article, absent from the supplied candidates.

id: W:fuller|troop morale and popular culture in the british and dominion armies 1914 1918
original_title: Troop Morale and Popular Culture in the British and Dominion Armies, 1914–1918
note: By J. G. Fuller, a different author from the candidate John Fuller. Library catalogues date the original to 1990; Oxford’s platform gives January 1991.

id: W:skelton|life and letters of sir wilfrid laurier
original_title: Life and Letters of Sir Wilfrid Laurier
note: Oscar Douglas Skelton’s two-volume biography, Toronto: S. B. Gundy/Oxford University Press, 1921. No candidates supplied.
